sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "station"."services" AS g, AVG("weekly_weather"."precipitation") AS m1, AVG(("weekly_weather"."high_temperature" - "weekly_weather"."low_temperature")) AS m2 FROM "weekly_weather" JOIN "station" ON "station"."id" = "weekly_weather"."station_id" GROUP BY "station"."services"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL
